name: Girls Go Fashion Party
storyline:
Without your help, Gwen, Gabriella, and Grace will be tardy to their party!

The girls have lost all sorts of things, like shoes, clothes, and makeup! You'll need to search their room high and low to find everything they need. Look in closets, under the bed, and even in locked cupboards!

Luckily, there are special items to help you in your search. You might find keys to open those pesky locks, a flashlight to see in dark places, and even an umbrella to reach things behind the bed.
summary: Use your eye for detail, your dress-up skills, and your makeover know-how to get the girls to the fashion party on time. First, find any missing items scattered around the house. You're looking for things like shoes, clothes, and make-up. Then head over to their closet and get them all gussied up—don't forget to apply make-up! Do all of this before time's up to get them out the door in time. It can be played on Flash archive websites nowadays.
